Current app scope

Supported formats and honest limits.

LensPin suggests missing locations for camera photos and optional videos already in Apple Photos, using timestamped GPX tracks, nearby geotagged iPhone photos, or both. Saving updates the Photos library location. Photos can separately be exported as JPG copies with GPS; original media files stay unchanged.

Last updated October 21, 2026

iOS / iPadOS 17+ · macOS 14+

Photos + optional videos · Apple Photos · Timestamped GPX tracks

Format name alone is not a guarantee.

An asset may be unavailable, lack readable capture-time or camera metadata, or be stored only in iCloud. A supported format name does not guarantee that every item can be matched. LensPin reports each library-location outcome separately and keeps original files unchanged.

Which items become candidates

LensPin filters before it suggests.

Automatic matching starts with items that have no library location.

Photos need readable camera and capture-time information; screenshots and unknown-camera images are excluded. Video scanning is off by default. When enabled, videos can be grouped as Unknown Camera if their camera model is missing. Items with existing locations are protected during automatic saving.

Video locations

One location for the start of recording.

A suggested video location represents the start of recording, not the complete route. Check movement warnings and recording times before saving, especially for slow-motion and time-lapse videos. Videos can be reviewed and have their library location adjusted or removed in the LensPin album, but cannot be exported with GPS by LensPin.

Library location and JPG export explained →

GPX input

Timestamped track points, not just a line.

The current parser accepts GPX 1.1 track points with valid latitude, longitude, and time. Original track segments remain separate, and implausible high-speed jumps are split for safety.

System behavior

System and iCloud considerations.

iOS 26 and later

LensPin can use the system's continued-processing task for a user-started scan while the app is backgrounded or the device is locked.

iOS 17–25

Background time is limited. LensPin keeps the screen awake during scanning; a long absence may pause the task until the app returns.

iCloud originals

Photos may need to download an original so LensPin can inspect camera and capture-time metadata. Saving an approved location still updates Apple Photos library metadata only.

LensPin

Native on iPhone (iOS 17+), iPad (iPadOS 17+), and Mac (macOS 14+). Add locations in Apple Photos on device; original files stay unchanged and existing locations are never overwritten.
